description: Devin (by Cognition) is an autonomous AI software engineer with an Organization API for sessions, knowledge, and playbooks, plus a separate Enterprise API.
access_notes: Cognition's own blog confirms 'self-serve plans for Devin', meaning signup and API key generation happen without a sales process, but Devin is a paid product (no free tier found) -- so API use requires an active paid plan. The Enterprise API tier (cross-org analytics, billing, audit logs) is further restricted to enterprise customers.
api_notes: Organization API: sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets, resource management. Enterprise API: cross-org analytics, audit logs, user management, billing.
main_blocker: Requires an active paid Devin plan; no free tier found.
